summary: UAPGerb tells of Bobby Ray Inman refers Bob Oechsler to Shapiro and Hineman, about 1988-1989 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Inman set up NURO and hinted to Bobby Oechsler that UFOs might come out

plain: Around 1988 or 1989, a senior official named Bobby Ray Inman is said to have spoken with Bob Oechsler, a UFO researcher described as a NASA mission specialist, NASA being the US space agency. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says Inman pointed Oechsler toward Sumner Shapiro, the director of naval intelligence, and a man named R. Evans Hineman. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it differently, saying that on the call Inman hinted that the UFO subject might come out into the open someday. It is told as a sign that people high in US intelligence knew about UFO matters.
